title_sq: Shitet biznes bar-kafe ne Laprake, i ngritur prej vitesh
description_sq:
Shitet biznes "Bar - Kafe" , prane bllokut Gintash ne Laprake , Tirane . 
Aktivitet i ngritur prej vitesh i cili vazhdon dhe aktualisht . 
Ambienti i Bar-Kafes i gjithi i investuar i perbere prej 2 kate , secili kat rreth 140 m2 x 2 = 280 m2 siperfaqe e brendshme e gjitha me certifikate pronesie . I pajisur me sistem kondicionimi e aspirimi , tavolina , kolltuqe etj . Gjithashtu hapsire e jashtme ku aktualisht ndodhen 10 tavolina me nga 4 karrike secila . 
Qiraja eshte 130.000 leke neto/muaj . 
Cmimi i shitjes se biznesit eshte 30.000 euro . Ne rast shitje te biznesit garantohet kontrate qiraje 5 vjecare me pronarin e objektit me cmim te pandryshueshem qiraje 130.000 leke neto ne muaj .
title_en: Bar-coffee business in Laprake, established for years, is for sale
description_en: "Bar - Coffee" business for sale, near the Gintash block in Laprake, Tirana. Activity set up for years which continues today. The Bar-Cafe environment, all invested, consists of 2 floors, each floor about 140 m2 x 2 = 280 m2 internal surface, all with ownership certificates. Equipped with air conditioning and aspiration system, tables, armchairs, etc. There is also an outdoor space where there are currently 10 tables with 4 chairs each. The rent is 130,000 lek net/month. The selling price of the business is 30,000 euros. In case of sale of the business, a 5-year rental contract is guaranteed with the owner of the building with an unchanging rental price of 130,000 lek net per month.
